items.source: Set the week date year to the value resolved by following the given field reference.
items.translation: 将周日期年份设置为通过遵循给定的字段引用解析的值。

items.source: Set the week date year to the result of the given expression.
items.translation: 将周日期年设置为给定expression的结果。

items.source: Set the year to the value resolved by following the given field reference.
items.translation: 将年份设置为通过遵循给定的字段引用解析的值。

items.source: Set the week date year to the given value which must resolve to a weekday in range 0 - 9999. Can be a simple value, field reference or expression.
items.translation: 将周日期年份设置为给定值，该值必须解析为范围 0 - 9999 内的一周中的某一天。 可以是简单值、字段引用 或 表达式。

items.source: Set the year to the given value which must resolve to a calendar year. Can be a simple value, field reference or expression.
items.translation: 将年份设置为给定值，该值必须解析为日历年份。可以是简单值、字段引用或表达式。

items.source: Set the week date year to the given value which must resolve to a weekday in range 0 - 9999.
items.translation: 将周日期年份设置为给定值，该值必须解析为范围 0 - 9999 内的某个工作日。

items.source: Set the year to the given value which must resolve to a calendar year.
items.translation: 将年份设置为给定值，该值必须解析为日历年份。

items.source: timezone - must not be null. Use DateOperators.Timezone.none() instead.
